# Ascend

> Free unofficial practice for the Digital SAT® exam. A climb, on purpose. Always free for students. MIT licensed.

I’m Chris, a high schooler from Dallas. Bluebook, Khan, and the other official tools are great, but a lot of them feel like homework. I made Ascend so practice is a short daily game: a mountain, a streak, no email required to try.

Use official Bluebook first (same app as test day). Then climb here about 15 minutes a day. Then Bluebook again. Not a College Board partner. Not a replacement.

- Live: https://chrishouseholderuser.github.io/climbwithascend/
- Intended public URL: https://climbwithsat.com (when the domain is pointed)
- Source (MIT): https://github.com/chrishouseholderuser/climbwithascend
- Pledge (students never pay): https://chrishouseholderuser.github.io/climbwithascend/pledge.html
- Privacy: https://chrishouseholderuser.github.io/climbwithascend/privacy.html
